justification: Pure bounded comparison, certificate identity policy, data-driven provider request policy, and allocation-free caller-owned request-head encoding over already validated caller-borrowed inputs. The additional-field path invokes only a caller-injected provider/trace audit sink before copying exact provider-policy-bound public Accept or Content-Type metadata; credential-bearing and custom fields fail closed. It directly performs no filesystem, network, process, environment, clock, FFI, credential access or edit, signing, TLS, HTTP I/O, or transport effect.
